title: Fix the Missing Closing Brace
description: The program should print a greeting message. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should compile and print 'Hello, World!'.
actualProblem: The class body is missing its closing brace, so the compiler reports 'reached end of file while parsing' and the program fails to compile.
explanation: Every opening brace { in Java must be matched by a closing brace }. A missing brace leaves a block unterminated, which the compiler detects only once it reaches the end of the file with braces still open.
